basic_info.description: This exceptional residence offers luxurious living across three spacious levels. The top floor is dedicated to the primary suite, featuring a fireplace, two large walk-in closets, and a private deck with breathtaking Golden Gate Bridge views.    The second level boasts an open-concept living area with a chef's kitchen, two bedrooms, a kids' bath, and a powder room. A bright sunroom offers flexible space for a playroom or office.    The bottom level is designed for entertaining with a second kitchen, large media room, wine cellar, and an additional bedroom with direct access to the backyard. The garage fits one car and includes an infrared sauna.    This home combines sophisticated design with functional living, offering an unparalleled lifestyle in one of San Francisco's most desirable neighborhoods. Located within walking distance of Chestnut Street, Crissy Field, the Palace of Fine Arts, and with easy access to the Golden Gate Bridge.
